summary: No repository holds phyllotactic fractions across species. The only open phyllotaxis counts found are 657 sunflower heads (a high-order case); other resources are image collections (GBIF, iDigBio) from which ratios would have to be scored, and a trait database whose request page does not mention phyllotaxis.
next_step: Compile 1/2, 2/3, 3/5, 5/8 and higher fractions per genus from botanical floras and phyllotaxis reviews, adding cones and rosettes from the literature; alternatively score a stratified image sample from GBIF with a pre-registered protocol.
obstacles_confirmed: Phyllotactic ratios are not routinely encoded in trait tables.
The only open ratio counts are for sunflower capitula.
Leaf-arrangement surveys remain in botanical compilations.
